tasks.title: Connect image and runtime provenance to boot inspection
tasks.goal: Explain package, environment, image and service contributions through the shared debugger and four selectable client profiles.
steps: Join domain-owned package/config/capture/producer/generation/image/service references without introducing a new authoritative graph.
Expose independent boot bytes/tokens, storage/download bytes and image-layer contributions with occurrence/shared/marginal semantics and unknown mappings.
Exercise Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Qwen Code as separate selectable image configurations and local launch contracts; no mandatory live model inference.
positive_cases: An installed executable and service navigate to their captured package and producer.
All four required client profiles have observed configuration and local launch evidence.
negative_cases: Storage or image size is labelled provider billing/token cost.
Missing client launch evidence is replaced with descriptor presence.
checks: TO CREATE: image/boot provenance and four-profile launch integration cases.
acceptance: Each claimed contribution and supported client profile has exact evidence.
Large boot remains streamable without a total token/size quota.
tasks.safe_stop: Captured views and per-profile results are retained; no customer credentials or real model call is used.
tasks.commit_subject: feat(image): expose environment and boot contribution provenance
notes: Planned permanent destination: vibevm/vibespecs/common/PROP-065-oci-agent-images.xml; forward metadata only.

tasks.title: Measure independent build reproducibility levels
tasks.goal: Compare two cache-disabled builds at explicit resolution, rootfs and OCI identity levels.
steps: Run two independent cache-disabled fixture builds from the same complete prepared inputs and record exact builder/target/recipe context.
Compare dependency resolution, installed content/metadata and declared OCI config/layer/manifest/index subjects independently; compare archive bytes only if claimed.
Account explicitly for volatile attestations/logs; do not normalize unexplained runtime changes away, and rerun with a missing input to prove refusal.
positive_cases: Equal installed inventories establish the precise content/metadata level.
Byte-identical OCI is claimed only when its exact declared subjects match.
negative_cases: Cache reuse or normalized rootfs equality is called byte-identical OCI.
Unexplained payload drift is removed by normalization.
checks: TO CREATE: two independent cache-disabled build comparison harness using M-15-K; archive comparison conditional on declared subject.
acceptance: The report states measured equality and inequality rather than a blanket reproducible label.
All-network-off replay has independent enforcement evidence.
tasks.safe_stop: Both artifacts and comparison evidence survive for review; clean only exact unused fixture resources.
notes: Planned permanent destination: vibevm/vibespecs/common/PROP-065-oci-agent-images.xml; forward metadata only.

tasks.title: Replace images and recover failed deployments
tasks.goal: Verify Docker update/remove/rollback and GC against actual live references and persistent data boundaries.
steps: Prepare and start a rebuilt generation from changed locked intent, verify readiness and switch only the explicitly managed local deployment.
Inject startup failure to retain/recover the prior image/config/runtime binding; rebuild after package removal rather than deleting a writable-container file.
Test image GC while old/live/recovery containers and exported artifacts retain references; preserve volumes and database contents throughout.
positive_cases: Verified replacement becomes active and failed startup restores an evidenced prior runtime.
Removing a package rebuilds a closure that retains shared dependencies.
negative_cases: Rollback claims to revert mutable service data/schema.
Global Docker prune or stale GC deletes a live image or unrelated resources.
checks: TO CREATE: local Docker replacement/removal/failed-start/GC integration scenarios.
acceptance: Runtime and data rollback are reported separately with exact partial effects.
Live-reference-safe GC deletes only recorded owned IDs.
tasks.safe_stop: A known usable runtime or explicit recovery state remains; mutable data is retained.

tasks.title: Prove the complete supply chain without GitHub
tasks.goal: Exercise bootstrap through local publication using independent local sources, mirrors, caches and OCI hosts.
steps: Prepare a local registry/source/artifact mirror/binary cache/OCI registry fixture with exact trusted captures for all transitive/bootstrap/client inputs.
Run bootstrap, resolve/fetch, source build and substitution, HOME lifecycle, image build/inspect and an explicitly admitted publication only to the local fixture registry.

Use M-15-K independent mediation/observation across controller, native children and builder/daemon workloads: local-only mode records zero GitHub/API/raw/release attempts; separate prepared replay denies every network path.
positive_cases: The complete delivered cycle works through local non-GitHub transports.
Offline replay succeeds from captured inputs with no hidden transport.
negative_cases: Only application HTTP counters are observed while children bypass policy.
A failed local source falls back to GitHub or an unobserved path is counted as proof.
checks: TO CREATE: complete no-GitHub and independent all-network-off supply-chain harness; retain observer coverage evidence.
acceptance: Every exercised process/transport class is covered by enforced and observed egress policy.
No host firewall/DNS edits, real publisher calls or public registry pushes occur.
tasks.safe_stop: Local publication artifacts/evidence retained; exact fixture endpoints and resources are cleaned.
